verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a browser-automation framework, so bulk operations across many items is a fair axis. The evidence shows only single-instruction primitives: act, extract with an output shape, and observe returning actions. It also covers an autonomous agent and WebMCP, which collapses one multi-click flow into a single call. None of these is documented as a capability to apply one operation across many items at once. Looping over observe() results in developer-written orchestration is a building block, not a product-level bulk feature.
